summary: International monitor return: customs paperwork + temporary courier badge and loading-bay access
description:
Issue summary:
Employee is returning two legacy 27" monitors from the Amsterdam office to the US repair vendor. We need coordination for: customs paperwork (commercial invoice + CN22/CN23 as required), temporary courier badge and escorted loading-bay access at the Amsterdam site, and correct asset tagging so inventory reflects the return.

Background:
- Monitors are end-of-life models; vendor repair location is in NJ, USA.
- Return initiated via request from the eu-west engineering team; weight per box ~12kg, 2 boxes.
- Asset tags: RWI-20312, RWI-20313. Serial numbers included below.

Impact:
- If customs paperwork is incomplete, courier will be delayed at export clearance causing missed SLA with vendor and potential storage fees.
- Security currently revoked temporary guest badges last week; courier needs escorted access to loading bay between 09:30-11:00 on pickup day.

Required actions / Acceptance criteria:
1) Facilities to confirm loading-bay slot and escort (Security to approve temporary day badge for courier).
2) Shipping to prepare and attach commercial invoice with USD value (zero for warranty? confirm with Vendor).
3) Inventory to update asset status to "in-transit return" with RMA number once shipped.
4) Customs forms scanned and attached to this ticket before courier arrival.

Logistics details:
- Pickup window requested: 2026-03-14 09:30-11:00 CET
- Pick-up address: Redwood Inference BV, Karperstraat 4, 1015 AB Amsterdam, Loading Bay B
- Courier: DHL Express (account on file: REDWOOD-DHL-03) - carrier to confirm weight and dimensions by 2026-03-13 EOD
- Declared contents: 2x 27" monitors (model: LG-2709X), unit declared value: $120 each (vendor RMA warranty - need confirmation if declared value should be $0)
- Asset tags & serials: RWI-20312 / SN-LG2709-54621, RWI-20313 / SN-LG2709-54622

Steps for Facilities / Security:
- Approve a temporary courier badge for driver name (to be provided by DHL 2026-03-13) for single day, time-limited to the loading bay only.
- Escort policy: one Facilities staff to meet courier at Loading Bay B, verify ID, witness pallet handover, sign pickup manifest.
- Provide pallet truck / two-person lift if needed (boxes ~12kg each).
- Ensure loading bay door code and gate open time confirmed with courier ETA.

Shipping / Inventory actions:
- Prepare commercial invoice and export paperwork (CN22/CN23 as needed) and attach scanned copies to ticket. Include RMA# when vendor provides it.
- Print two copies of the manifest for courier and Facilities sign-off.
- Update internal asset management entry to status: "pending pickup" and set owner to "vendor-return".

Contacts:
- Reporter: Maya Chen (Facilities request) - maya.chen@redwood.ai / +31 20 555 0142
- Facilities lead: Derek Alvarez - derek.alvarez@redwood.ai / +1 415 555 0123
- Shipping coordinator: Priya Singh - priya.singh@redwood.ai
- Security: campus-security-eu@redwood.ai
- Vendor contact: Atlas Repair Co. (RMA team) - rma@atlasrepair.example / +1 908 555 2001

Deadline: All paperwork and temp badge approval must be completed by 2026-03-13 18:00 CET to meet pickup window.

Notes / Risks:
- Customs classification code for monitors must be correct to avoid VAT/levy assessment; Shipping to confirm HS code 8528.52 or vendor-specified code.
- If vendor insists on zero declared value, require written confirmation from vendor to avoid customs penalties.

Attachments expected before pickup:
- Scanned commercial invoice
- Courier pickup manifest (draft)
